title: Twelve Monkeys Matata Shorfill 100ml
description: Matata by Twelve Monkeys delivers a vibrant mix of rich, dark Grape and crisp Apple, creating a dynamic contrast of bold sweetness and bright, fruity freshness. The deep, juicy notes of Grape hit on the inhale, while the crisp, refreshing Apple rounds out the exhale for a well-balanced finish. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Matata is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring dense vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. Twelve Monkeys is an award-winning Canadian e-liquid brand known for its expertly blended fruit flavours, offering premium-quality ingredients and bold profiles for an exceptional vaping experience.
